result.title: Razavi-Bench: Tracking AI Progress in Analog Circuit Reasoning
result.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Project page: https://razavi-bench.tokenzhang.com ; code and data: https://github.com/Arcadia-1/razavi-bench
result.summary: We propose Razavi-Bench, a benchmark built from the 50 questions in Razavi's two Analog Design Experiments With AI articles and graded by GPT-6 Luna against reference answers and rubrics, and use it to track how fast AI models improve at analog circuit analysis. Across 73 multimodal large language models released between May 2024 and November 2026, the top score rose from 28.83% to 98.33% in 30 months, mostly before the reference answers were published. The leading models now answer almost every textbook question correctly; the hardest questions show a circuit that resembles a textbook one but works differently, or ask about behavior the obvious analysis misses. Within two and a half years, a set of questions that exposed the limits of AI models has become one they answer almost perfectly.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 Razavi-Bench：用 50 道模拟电路设计题，由 GPT-6 Luna 依参考答案与评分细则打分，追踪 2024 年 5 月至 2026 年 11 月间 73 个多模态大模型的电路分析能力变化，最高分从 28.83% 升至 98.33%。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属较远领域，但其「貌似教材电路而机理不同」「直觉分析会漏掉的行为」这类题目，可能可供核查模型是否依赖视觉相似性先验而忽略图形细节，为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与表面捷径的对照提供参照。
